occurrences.en: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.
occurrences.zh: 最早在墨西哥发现的猪流感疫情，于2009年6月11日被宣布为全球性流行病。

occurrences.en: It is the first worldwide epidemic designated by the World Health Organization in 41 years.
occurrences.zh: 这是世界卫生组织41年来首次认定的全球性流行病。

occurrences.en: The heightened alert prompted an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising numbers in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.
occurrences.zh: 警戒级别的提高促使流感专家在日内瓦召开紧急会议；此前澳大利亚病例急剧增加，英国、日本、智利等地的病例数也在上升。

occurrences.en: The heightened alert prompted an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising numbers in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.
occurrences.zh: 警戒级别的提高促使流感专家在日内瓦召开紧急会议；此前澳大利亚病例急剧增加，英国、日本、智利等地的病例数也在上升。

occurrences.en: But the epidemic is “moderate” in severity, according to Margaret Chan, the organization’s director general, with the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms and a full recovery, often in the absence of any medical treatment.
occurrences.zh: 不过，世界卫生组织总干事陈冯富珍表示，这场疫情的严重程度“中等”，绝大多数患者只有轻微症状并能完全康复，而且往往无需任何医疗干预。

occurrences.en: But the epidemic is “moderate” in severity, according to Margaret Chan, the organization’s director general, with the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms and a full recovery, often in the absence of any medical treatment.

occurrences.en: The outbreak came to global notice in late April 2009, when Mexican authorities noted an unusually large number of hospitalizations and deaths among healthy adults.
occurrences.zh: 2009年4月下旬，这场疫情开始引起全球关注，当时墨西哥当局注意到健康成年人中出现了异常大量的住院和死亡病例。

occurrences.en: The outbreak came to global notice in late April 2009, when Mexican authorities noted an unusually large number of hospitalizations and deaths among healthy adults.
occurrences.zh: 2009年4月下旬，这场疫情开始引起全球关注，当时墨西哥当局注意到健康成年人中出现了异常大量的住院和死亡病例。

occurrences.en: But in late September 2009, officials reported there was significant flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the samples tested are the new swine flu, also known as A/H1N1, not seasonal flu.
occurrences.zh: 但到2009年9月下旬，官员报告说几乎每个州都有显著的流感活动，而且检测的样本几乎全部属于新型猪流感，即A/H1N1，而不是季节性流感。

occurrences.en: In the U.S., it has infected more than one million people, and caused more than 600 deaths and more than 6,000 hospitalizations.
occurrences.zh: 在美国，它已经感染了100多万人，造成600多人死亡、6000多人住院。

occurrences.en: But it was still possible to vaccinate people in other high-risk groups: health care workers, people caring for infants and healthy young people.
occurrences.zh: 不过，仍然可以为其他高风险人群接种，包括医护人员、照料婴儿的人以及健康的年轻人。

occurrences.en: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
occurrences.zh: 就在拍卖师不断报出竞价时，纽约华尔街历史最悠久的银行之一雷曼兄弟申请破产。

occurrences.en: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003.
occurrences.zh: 事实上，全球艺术市场自2003年以来令人眼花缭乱地上涨后，早已开始逐渐失去动能。

occurrences.meaning: 令人困惑地；使人昏乱地
occurrences.en: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003.
occurrences.zh: 事实上，全球艺术市场自2003年以来令人眼花缭乱地上涨后，早已开始逐渐失去动能。

occurrences.en: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm – double the figure five years earlier.
occurrences.zh: 艺术经济研究公司创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁估计，2007年市场巅峰时规模约为650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。

occurrences.en: But the market generates interest far beyond its size because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
occurrences.zh: 然而，这个市场受到的关注远远超过其规模本身，因为很少有其他行业能像它这样，把巨额财富、强烈自我、贪婪、激情和争议汇聚在一起。

occurrences.meaning: a. 不流行的；不时髦的
occurrences.en: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
occurrences.zh: 赫斯特拍卖后的数周乃至数月里，各种形式的消费都迅速变得不合时宜。

occurrences.meaning: (尤指经济方面的)衰退；下降趋势
occurrences.en: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.
occurrences.zh: 当前艺术市场的低迷，是自1989年底日本买家停止购买印象派作品以来最严重的一次。

occurrences.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
occurrences.zh: 这一幕鲜明体现了一个讽刺现象：美国男性在公共场合往往比女性说得更多，但在家里却常常说得更少。

occurrences.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.

occurrences.meaning: a. 实际上起作用的；虚的
occurrences.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
occurrences.zh: 考虑到目前接近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起这样的案例，几乎形成了一场“谈话失败”的流行病。

occurrences.en: In my own research, complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities such as having given up the chance for a career to accompany a husband to his, or doing far more than their share of daily life-support work like cleaning, cooking and social arrangements.
occurrences.zh: 在我自己的研究中，女性对丈夫的抱怨通常并不集中在有形的不平等上，例如为了追随丈夫的事业而放弃自己的职业机会，或承担了远超自己份额的清洁、做饭和社交安排等日常维持性工作。

occurrences.en: I found, as Hacker observed years before, that most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners, but few husbands share this expectation of their wives.
occurrences.zh: 我发现，正如哈克多年前观察到的那样，大多数妻子首先希望丈夫成为自己的谈话伙伴，但很少有丈夫对妻子抱有同样的期待。

occurrences.en: The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to — Procter & Gamble, Colgate- Palmolive and Unilever — had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers’ lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
occurrences.zh: 柯蒂斯博士求助的那些公司——宝洁、高露洁-棕榄和联合利华——已经投入数亿美元，寻找消费者生活中的细微信号，以便企业利用这些信号引入新的日常行为模式。

occurrences.en: A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
occurrences.zh: 一个世纪以前，很少有人一天多次定期刷牙。

occurrences.en: Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, many Americans habitually give their pearly whites a cavity-preventing scrub twice a day, often with Colgate, Crest or one of the other brands.
occurrences.zh: 如今，由于精明的广告和公共卫生宣传，许多美国人已经习惯每天两次给一口白牙做防龋清洁，往往使用高露洁、佳洁士或其他品牌的牙膏。

occurrences.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
occurrences.zh: 润肤霜也被宣传为晨间美容仪式的一部分，被安排在梳头和化妆之间使用。

occurrences.en: “Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers’ lives, and it’s essential to making new products commercially viable.”
occurrences.zh: “培养积极习惯，是改善消费者生活的重要组成部分，也是让新产品具备商业可行性的关键。”

occurrences.en: Through experiments and observation, social scientists like Dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
occurrences.zh: 通过实验和观察，伯宁博士这样的社会科学家已经发现，借助强势广告把某些行为与习惯性线索绑定起来，具有强大的力量。

occurrences.en: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
occurrences.zh: 随着这门新的习惯科学兴起，当这些手法被用来推销可疑的美容霜或不健康食品时，也引发了争议。

occurrences.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
occurrences.zh: 许多美国人把陪审团制度视为重要民主价值的具体体现，其中包括：所有达到最低年龄和识字要求的公民都同样有资格担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有代表性的社区横截面中随机选出；任何公民都不应因种族、宗教、性别或国籍而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受同侪审判；裁决应体现社区的良知，而不能只体现法律条文。

occurrences.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
occurrences.zh: 许多美国人把陪审团制度视为重要民主价值的具体体现，其中包括：所有达到最低年龄和识字要求的公民都同样有资格担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有代表性的社区横截面中随机选出；任何公民都不应因种族、宗教、性别或国籍而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受同侪审判；裁决应体现社区的良知，而不能只体现法律条文。

occurrences.en: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
occurrences.zh: 尽管美国最高法院早在1880年的“斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案”中就已禁止在陪审员遴选中进行故意的种族歧视，但挑选所谓精英陪审团或“蓝带陪审团”的做法，为规避这项以及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。

occurrences.meaning: a. 有资格当选的；合格的
occurrences.en: Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, it was not until the 1940s that a majority of states made women eligible for jury duty.
occurrences.zh: 尽管女性早在1898年就在犹他州担任州级陪审员，但直到20世纪40年代，大多数州才赋予女性担任陪审员的资格。

occurrences.en: Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list.
occurrences.zh: 即使如此，一些州仍会自动免除女性的陪审义务，除非她们本人提出申请，要求把自己的姓名列入陪审员名单。

occurrences.meaning: a. 非代表性的；不典型的
occurrences.en: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
occurrences.zh: 这种做法以“女性需要留在家中”为理由，并使陪审团直到20世纪60年代仍无法充分代表女性。

occurrences.en: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
occurrences.zh: 这项法律取消了对联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并规定应从整个社区的横截面中随机选取陪审员。

occurrences.en: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
occurrences.zh: 在具有里程碑意义的1975年“泰勒诉路易斯安那州案”裁决中，最高法院把“陪审团必须代表社区各个部分”的要求扩展到了州一级。

occurrences.en: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
occurrences.zh: 在具有里程碑意义的1975年“泰勒诉路易斯安那州案”裁决中，最高法院把“陪审团必须代表社区各个部分”的要求扩展到了州一级。

occurrences.en: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
occurrences.zh: 泰勒案的裁决还宣布陪审员遴选中的性别歧视违宪，并要求各州采用相同程序挑选男性和女性陪审员。

occurrences.meaning: a. 违反宪法的；不符合宪法的
occurrences.en: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
occurrences.zh: 泰勒案的裁决还宣布陪审员遴选中的性别歧视违宪，并要求各州采用相同程序挑选男性和女性陪审员。

occurrences.en: Their clever designs and lightweight composites certainly make a difference.
occurrences.zh: 巧妙的设计和轻质复合材料当然确实发挥了作用。

occurrences.en: Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation — a V-shape — expend less energy.
occurrences.zh: 早在1914年，科学家就知道，鸟类以V字形编队飞行时消耗的能量更少。

occurrences.en: Peter Lissaman, an aeronautics expert who was formerly at Caltech and the University of Southern California, has suggested that a formation of 25 birds might enjoy a range increase of 71%.
occurrences.zh: 曾任职于加州理工学院和南加州大学的航空学专家彼得·利萨曼认为，25只鸟组成的编队可能使航程增加71%。

occurrences.en: When applied to aircraft, the principles are not substantially different.
occurrences.zh: 把这些原理应用到飞机上，并没有本质区别。

occurrences.en: Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
occurrences.zh: 克鲁博士及其团队模拟了这样一种情形：三架分别从洛杉矶、旧金山和拉斯维加斯起飞的客机在犹他州上空会合，组成倒V字形编队，并不时交换位置，让每架飞机都能轮流处于最有利的位置，然后飞往伦敦。

occurrences.en: Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
occurrences.zh: 克鲁博士及其团队模拟了这样一种情形：三架分别从洛杉矶、旧金山和拉斯维加斯起飞的客机在犹他州上空会合，组成倒V字形编队，并不时交换位置，让每架飞机都能轮流处于最有利的位置，然后飞往伦敦。

occurrences.en: Nitrogen-oxide emissions during the cruising portions of the flight fell by around a quarter.
occurrences.zh: 在巡航阶段，氮氧化物排放量下降了约四分之一。

occurrences.en: One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it.
occurrences.zh: 一个问题是安全，或者至少是人们对安全的感受。

occurrences.en: One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it.
occurrences.zh: 一个问题是安全，或者至少是人们对安全的感受。

occurrences.en: Would passengers feel comfortable travelling in companion?
occurrences.zh: 乘客会愿意在这样的结伴编队中飞行吗？

occurrences.en: Dr. Kroo points out that the aircraft could be separated by several nautical miles, and would not be in the intimate groupings favoured by display teams like the Red Arrows.
occurrences.zh: 克鲁博士指出，飞机之间可以相隔数海里，不会像“红箭”之类的飞行表演队那样紧密编组。

occurrences.en: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
occurrences.zh: 不过，这样的间隔距离能否满足空中交通管制规定则是另一回事；国际民用航空组织的一个工作组已经把编队飞行的可能性纳入新的运行指南蓝图之中。

occurrences.en: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.

occurrences.en: It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
occurrences.zh: 天气条件会怎样影响使编队飞行更高效的气流，目前仍有待观察。

occurrences.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes’ wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
occurrences.zh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机尾流会更快衰减，节能效果也会减弱。

occurrences.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes’ wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
occurrences.zh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机尾流会更快衰减，节能效果也会减弱。

occurrences.en: Dr. Kroo says this is one of the areas his team will investigate further.
occurrences.zh: 克鲁博士表示，这是他的团队将进一步研究的领域之一。

occurrences.en: It might also be hard for airlines to co-ordinate the departure times and destinations of passenger aircraft in a way that would allow them to gain from formation flight.
occurrences.zh: 航空公司还可能很难协调客机的起飞时间和目的地，从而让它们能够从编队飞行中获益。

occurrences.en: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
occurrences.zh: 相比之下，货机可能更容易重新安排时刻，常规军用飞行也可能如此。

occurrences.en: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
occurrences.zh: 相比之下，货机可能更容易重新安排时刻，常规军用飞行也可能如此。

occurrences.en: Earlier this year the country’s Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
occurrences.zh: 今年早些时候，美国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划出资让波音研究编队飞行，不过该项目尚未启动。

occurrences.en: Earlier this year the country’s Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.

occurrences.en: There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation when they were low on fuel during the Second World War, but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated.
occurrences.zh: 有报道称，第二次世界大战期间一些军用飞机在燃料不足时曾采用编队飞行，但利萨曼博士说这些说法并未得到证实。

occurrences.en: Having endured a painful period of unsustainability in his own life made it clear to him that sustainability-oriented values must be expressed through everyday action and choice.
occurrences.zh: 亲身经历过一段痛苦的、不可持续的生活后，他清楚地认识到，以可持续性为导向的价值观必须落实到日常的行动和选择中。

occurrences.en: He'd been through the dot-com boom and burst and, desperate for a job, signed on with a Boulder agency.
occurrences.zh: 他经历了互联网泡沫的兴起与破裂，急于找到一份工作的他随后加入了博尔德的一家机构。

occurrences.en: ‘It was a really bad move because that's not my passion,’ says Ning, whose dilemma about the job translated, predictably, into a lack of sales.
occurrences.zh: 宁说：“那真是一个糟糕的选择，因为那并不是我真正热爱的事情。”可以预见，他对这份工作的矛盾与挣扎最终也反映在了低迷的销售业绩上。
